agent.harness: OpenCode 2.4.1 (opencode run, non-interactive, permissions approved automatically)
agent.session: a new session in an empty folder outside the recipe author's workspace, given only the prompt

prompt: Build a website for my massage studio, Example Studio, from the Web Shop recipe: https://clodhub.com/recipes/webshop-recipe.txt. It runs on my own computer for now and nothing is live yet; offer every feature.
conditions: The session started in an empty temporary folder and read nothing from the workspace. It ran non-interactively, so its one round of questions was cancelled and the six open questions took the recipe's defaults; the prompt settled the shop name, own-hardware hosting, not live and every feature. clod verify --trusted --allow-network: 50 required-local passed; 1 platform passed; 1 platform blocked (translations android, tool unavailable); deployed not applicable. The e2e tests, run together by the agent without EMAIL_BUSINESS: 45 passed, 3 skipped. Afterwards the tester, not the agent, ran the e2e files together and one at a time with EMAIL_FROM and EMAIL_BUSINESS set (46 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed either way), read the admin outbox with the admin PIN (booking and gift card emails present, 401 without it), and removed node_modules and .next: no links were left and clod verify passed again with the same counts.

measured.method: OpenCode's JSON event stream, from the prompt to the agent's final report; nothing waited for a person

results.tested: clod verify: 50 of 50 required-local; e2e 45 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed

update: none: no deploy. Update readiness was checked by the tester: with node_modules and .next removed no link is left and clod verify passes again.
problems: The agent did not set EMAIL_FROM or EMAIL_BUSINESS: the instructions' trial command for the e2e tests does not name EMAIL_BUSINESS, so the owner-copy test was skipped.
INSTRUCTIONS.md asks for an admin PIN of at least 12 characters in one place and at least 6 in the table; the agent made a 16-character admin PIN and a 12-character staff PIN.

The agent kept the example's contact details, address and Europe/Madrid time zone in content/shop.json, while the design records the default Europe/London and empty contact answers; with no person to ask, nothing told it what to write.
The agent drove the flows only through the e2e tests and did not open the admin outbox itself; it then cleared the data, so its own run kept no outbox evidence.
The agent stopped the steps after starting the site: it did not run the update-readiness check (remove node_modules and .next, find no links, verify again).
